brief: Inbound contact-form submissions are routed to a sales team or dropped. Rule: if the message is not a sales inquiry (a job seeker, a vendor pitching us, a support request from an existing customer, or unrelated), route to none. Otherwise route by headcount: 1000 or more employees to enterprise, 100 to 999 to mid_market, fewer than 100 to smb.
input_shape: { company: string, employees: number, message: string }
